command: const fs=require('node:fs');const crypto=require('node:crypto');const assert=require('node:assert/strict');const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const hash=b=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');const snapshot=fs.readFileSync('learning\\S064\\evidence\\red\\shard-handoff.feature.snapshot');const originalRawSha256=hash(snapshot);const canonicalSnapshot=Buffer.from(snapshot.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'));const gitSource=execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:learning/S064/shard-handoff.feature']);assert.equal(hash(canonicalSnapshot),hash(gitSource));assert.equal(hash(fs.readFileSync('learning\\S064\\evidence\\red\\shard-handoff.feature.snapshot')),originalRawSha256);console.log(JSON.stringify({result:'PASS: canonical LF Git source matches retained RED feature; original CRLF raw proof unchanged',originalRawSha256,canonicalSnapshotSha256:hash(canonicalSnapshot),gitSourceSha256:hash(gitSource)},null,2));
